summary: Former Young Turks host turned right-wing YouTuber Dave Rubin, who rebranded as a classical liberal after 2016, platformed far-right guests without pushback, and wrote the 2020 book Don't Burn This Book.

evidence.note: early-2000s comedy podcast and public access parody news show around 2000
gets The Rubin Report on The Young Turks network around 2013
2016 pivot to hosting Intellectual Dark Web guests, aided by YouTube's algorithm
platforms Milo, Cernovich, Lauren Southern and Molyneux without pushback
Koch-linked funding, Blaze hosting and colleague calling him a fraud
book's origin story: Larry Elder interview on systemic racism
book's drug chapter: legalise some drugs, prison for meth and heroin users
book's abortion chapter and sex education culture-war discussion
book claims Nazis were socialists; host rebuts with Night of the Long Knives

notes: Roughly half biographical essay, half reading of Don't Burn This Book; media-reading chosen by format precedence. Lifetime rule not applied: covered span runs from his early-2000s comedy career to the 2020 book. Birth year 1976 from general knowledge (packet garbles it). Wikidata omitted.
